title: Optional live bias-pack smoke against JEV

## Goal
Optional live smoke that runs `BIAS_PACK_V1` against pinned JEV (`typesafe/jev-1.13`) once when `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is present; skip cleanly when absent.

- Add `scripts/smoke_bias.py` and/or a pytest mark that:
